headline: Reference-free transcriptome QC and indexed pangenome graph formats for sequence analysis
label: Genomic Sequence Analysis Tools
summary: Current aligners and quantifiers now support reference-free assembly QC, while indexed formats enable disk-based access to pangenome graph alignments.
synthesis: The shared thread is software infrastructure for handling and assessing sequence-derived data rather than new biological inference. pyTransRate reimplements TransRate in Python for reference-free quality assessment of de novo transcriptome assemblies, using snap and salmon, and reports that its metrics match the original. GBZ-base and GAF-base define SQLite-backed indexed formats for pangenome graphs and sequence-to-graph alignments, enabling disk-based subgraph access. rustybam provides a Rust CLI for CIGAR-aware PAF and BAM alignment manipulation, alongside the SafFire browser tool for genome comparison visualization, both open source. The novelty lies in indexed on-disk access to graph alignments and in reference-free evaluation paired with current aligners. Performance beyond the reported validations is not established by these items.
